rationale: Disabling both ANCOMBC variants and clearing their independently evaluated formula parameters prevents the entire QIIME2_ANCOM subworkflow from being invoked, since standard ANCOM is already disabled in the baseline. MULTIQC is affected by the changed parameter summary, and SUMMARY_REPORT receives empty differential abundance result inputs instead of the baseline ANCOMBC and ANCOMBC2 outputs. Metadata processing remains necessary for diversity analysis, so METADATA_ALL, METADATA_PAIRWISE and the diversity analysis processes are unaffected.
